units.source_text: 古歌：“托身苍松上，紫藤虽弱小，但得熏风吹，花开无限好。”

en.t: An old poem says: "Though the wisteria that has entrusted itself to the green pine is weak, when the fragrant breeze blows, its blossoms open in boundless beauty."
This appears in The Six Tomes of Ancient and Modern Japanese Poems.

units.source_text: 引用此诗，意思是说我已得内大臣许可。

en.t: By quoting this poem, I mean that I have already obtained the Inner Minister's permission.
